notes.mineru_command: Prefer CONTEXTURE_MINERU_COMMAND or an explicit mineru executable path in production.
notes.paddle_python: Prefer CONTEXTURE_PADDLE_PYTHON or an explicit GPU Paddle virtualenv python.exe in production.
notes.tesseract_command: Future OCR backend; use a system Tesseract binary or OCR sidecar.
notes.paddleocr_vl_runtime: Future VLM specialized backend; follow PaddleOCR-VL upstream protocol.
notes.mineru_vl_runtime: Future VLM specialized backend; follow MinerU-VL upstream protocol.
notes.future_backends: Tesseract belongs to OCR; PaddleOCR-VL and MinerU-VL belong to VLM specialized backends.
